title: A rare look inside Amazon's AI chip design lab
key_facts: Annapurna Labs is Amazon's chip design centre in Austin, Texas.
The chips developed there help power AI workloads for some of the world's largest companies.
BBC Tech Now presenter Paul Carter was given exclusive access to see how these specialised processors are designed and what role they play in the AI industry.
The video is from Tech Now, the BBC's flagship technology programme.
